question: If we have a very small amount of additional memory , but a large number of items to sort, which of the following sorting algorithm should we use?
explanation:
Why Merge Sort is ideal for this scenario:
Time Complexity:
Merge Sort has a time complexity of O(n log n), which is efficient for large datasets. This means its performance scales well with the size of the data.
Memory Usage:
The key advantage of Merge Sort is its minimal memory usage. It only requires temporary storage for merging sorted sub-arrays, which is significantly less than the size of the original data.
Other options and considerations:
Heap Sort:
While also having a time complexity of O(n log n), Heap Sort might require slightly more memory due to the need for a heap data structure.
QuickSort:
QuickSort has an average time complexity of O(n log n) but can degenerate to O(n^2) in the worst case.
External Sorting:
For truly massive datasets that won\"t fit in memory, external sorting techniques are used.
